QuestInfo.name: [Sizzling Santa] Bye to the Team
QuestInfo.0: Now it's time to say goodbye to your Grand Santa Contest team.\r\nGo see Louie.
QuestInfo.1: Go say goodbye to each of your teammates.
QuestInfo.2: The Grand Santa Contest has ended and the team has left. You hope that they will continue to improve in their own ways.\r\nThe contest is over, but you may return to the workshop at any time.

default.0: The rest of the team is going to go back to their regular lives. Maybe you should say goodbye.
